title: Independence from factorization of fiber probabilities
statement:
Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $S$ and $T$ be finite sets. Let $X : \Omega \to S$ and $Y : \Omega \to T$ be measurable maps such that, for every $x \in S$ and $y \in T$,
\[
  \mu\bigl(X^{-1}\{x\} \cap Y^{-1}\{y\}\bigr) = \mu\bigl(X^{-1}\{x\}\bigr)\cdot \mu\bigl(Y^{-1}\{y\}\bigr),
\]
where each measure is taken as a real number. Then $X$ and $Y$ are independent under $\mu$.
